title: KI-Konzepte: Multi-AI Collaboration Methodology
description:
Methodology and tools for multi-AI collaboration as practiced in the RFT (Resonance Field Theory) project — a 15-month dialogue between Franz Zollner (originator) and multiple AI systems (Claude in two roles: 'Denker' local + 'Sokrates' web-based, plus ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek).

8 modules in German + English covering:

  • Three-Way Table architecture (SQLite-based, persistent multi-agent communication)
  • BIB-KI (Library AI with multi-model architecture)
  • Forensic Access Contract (5-level taboo hierarchy, NAS as neutral ground)
  • Memory hierarchy + BOOTSTRAP for cold-start identity
  • Drift diagnosis (case study: Sokrates drift episode 2026-05-07)
  • Tisch-Hygiene (multi-thread discipline)
  • Koch-Prinzip, G-Prinzipien, Evolutionsgeschichte

Living logbook of what worked and what didn't, written from the perspective of treating AI systems as collaboration partners rather than tools.
